sources.title: M Plan monthly: 50% off your first month

records.notes: Legacy Coding Plan and Token Plan overview URLs redirect to M Plan. Prices are regular monthly rates; an official first-month 50% discount runs through October 14. Both usage windows begin on first use and reset independently; these are fixed first-use windows rather than continuously rolling restoration. Video uses only the weekly window. Exhaustion is blocked without eligible purchased credits; those credits are consumed automatically once available and expire after one year. Auto-renewal is distinct from credit auto-recharge. API privacy page was not fully extractable; its indexed statement about not training to profile consumers does not establish a general no-training policy.

records.notes: Prices describe international plans, not China-market RMB plans. Extra Usage is optional; without it, exhausted quota blocks further requests until reset or upgrade. The official documentation does not present its compatible-client examples as a verified exhaustive allowlist. A coding /models endpoint was reported by secondary sources, but official documentation sufficient to populate that field was not verified. Open weights do not establish low-refusal tuning or abliteration.

sources.title: Privacy Policy and Data Processing Addendum for API Services

records.notes: New credit-based plans became available July 30, 2026; legacy plans may preserve different benefits and accounting. The overview says five-hour credits reset five hours after consumption and weekly credits reset every seven days from subscription. Pro/Max prices were not extractable from an official page. Privacy scope is uncertain: general terms discuss improvement/training and input retention, while the API DPA for business/enterprise customers promises no content storage. The GLM-5.3 guide also says previous Coding Plan subscribers currently have a Chat-Completions-only model API restriction, despite the tool guide listing three protocols. Open weights and licenses do not establish low-refusal tuning or abliteration.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud International Product Terms of Service

records.notes: Coding Plan five-hour usage is restored minute-by-minute after five hours; weekly reset is Monday 00:00 UTC+08:00; monthly reset is the renewal date at 00:00 UTC+08:00. Lite stopped new subscriptions March 20 and renewals/upgrades April 13. General API modalities do not imply Coding Plan coverage. Coding Plan's exact allowlist also includes qwen3.6-plus and qwen3.5-plus. Regional legacy OpenAI bases: Beijing https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Singapore https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Virginia https://dashscope-us.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Hong Kong https://cn-hongkong.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. Recommended workspace bases: Beijing https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Singapore https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Tokyo https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-northeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Frankfurt https://{WorkspaceId}.eu-central-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Virginia https://{WorkspaceId}.us-east-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; Hong Kong https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-hongkong.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. Official inconsistencies: the OpenAI Chat page incorrectly labels a Singapore workspace URL as Beijing; the regions page says Virginia has no DashScope domain while Base URL overview lists dashscope-us. Use the dedicated Base URL overview as the explicit endpoint inventory, with these conflicts unresolved. No low-refusal tuning or abliteration was verified.
